name: aribs-erp-server
description: ARIBS ERP - NestJS backend + React frontend, deployed together as one Node.js app (backend serves the built frontend).

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev
scripts.check: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd ../frontend && npx tsc -b
